changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwallergens AS SELECT a.id, a.name, a.is_active, a.type, a.description, a.created_by, a.created_date, a.last_modified_by, a.last_modified_date FROM public.allergens a;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwallergens TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON report.allergens FROM report_user;
